# DayRecall

> DayRecall is an AI memory app for Apple Watch and iPhone. During the hours you choose, it listens and turns speech into text on your iPhone. There is no account or DayRecall server receiving your day. To-dos, recaps and answers use this iPhone by default, or your own API after you configure it and allow sharing. The API can receive new transcripts automatically, not only when you ask a question.

DayRecall 是适用于 Apple Watch 和 iPhone 的 AI 记忆 App，在你选定的时段聆听，并在 iPhone 上把说的话转成文字。不用账号，也没有接收你一天内容的 DayRecall 服务器。待办、复盘和回答默认使用本机，也可在配置并授权后使用自己的 API。API 可能自动收到新转写，并非只有提问时才收到内容。

## Key facts

- Devices: best with Apple Watch; an iPhone can also listen on its own. When both listen, the day is one timeline, and what both heard is shown once. Requires an iPhone with iOS 26 or later and Apple's on-device speech recognition (iPhone 12 or later recommended; iPhone 11 models and iPhone SE (2nd generation) lack it). Apple Watch is optional: watchOS 26 or later (Series 6 and later, SE (2nd generation) and later, any Ultra).
- The watch does not need the iPhone nearby. It holds what it heard and hands it to the iPhone every two hours, or as soon as the two reconnect.
- On the watch, an in-house ultra-light speech model (2,561 parameters, custom accelerated inference kernels) checks every 0.1 seconds whether someone is talking and keeps only speech.
- Lab results for that model: 99.9% of speech kept on the AMI Meeting Corpus test set; 95% of background-noise time skipped on the DEMAND dataset.
- Internal testing: on Apple Watch Series 11, listening adds about 0.9% battery per hour; on iPhone 17 Pro Max, 3 minutes of conversation are processed in 17 seconds.
- Speech is transcribed on the iPhone, and audio is cleared after transcription. One AI engine handles to-dos, recaps and answers: On this iPhone by default, or My own API, an OpenAI-compatible service. Once the user selects and allows the API, it receives batches of new transcripts with times and speaker labels for to-dos; included conversations from a selected day, with recorded places, when the user requests a recap; and questions with matching excerpts for answers. A question may first be sent alone to expand search terms, even when no excerpts are later found. Audio and voiceprints are never sent to the API. Earlier question-only sharing permission must be renewed.
- 语音在 iPhone 上转写，转写完成后清除音频。待办、复盘和回答共用一个 AI 引擎：默认的“这台 iPhone”，或兼容 OpenAI 接口的“我自己的 API”。用户选择并授权 API 后，它会分批收到用于找待办的新转写、时间和说话人标注；请求复盘时收到所选一天中勾选的对话及已有地点；提问时收到问题和匹配片段。问题也可能先单独发出以扩充检索词，即使之后没有找到片段。音频和声纹不会发给 API。旧的仅限提问的共享授权需要重新确认。
- Optional speaker marking: after reading five short cards (about a minute), the user's lines are marked "Me" and everyone else "Other 1", "Other 2" and so on. Only the user's voiceprint is stored, on the iPhone.
- Optional Health clues are read on the iPhone after the user enables them. Inputs used by the App are kept in a protected local cache and can be included in a password-encrypted manual backup the user creates; they are not sent to DayRecall. Raw Health records and numerical measurements are not attached to to-do or question requests. Health labels and activity times are included in a recap written by the user’s API, or a day handed to an AI app, only if the user chooses to add them on the recap and hand-over page. The switch is off by default, asks when turned on and remembers the choice. Heart rate, step and distance figures are not included. The clipboard shortcut never includes Health information. No medical conclusions or health advice are given.
- 可选健康线索由用户开启后在 iPhone 上读取。应用读取并使用的输入保存在受保护的本机缓存中，可以包含在用户主动创建的密码加密手动备份里，不发送给 DayRecall。查找待办或提问不会附上“健康”原始记录或数值。只有用户在复盘和交出页面选择附上时，健康标签和活动时段才会包含在由自己的 API 撰写的复盘，或交给 AI App 的一天中。开关默认关闭，打开时会询问，并记住选择。不包含心率、步数或距离数值。剪贴板快捷指令从不包含健康信息。不下医学结论，也不提供健康建议。
- Optional multilingual transcription: up to three languages in one conversation, each part transcribed in the language it was spoken in, with translation into the user's language. The app itself is available in 14 languages.
- Transcription and translation depend on Apple’s on-device technology, the iPhone and iOS version. For to-dos, recaps and answers, On this iPhone depends on Apple Intelligence and its device, language and region requirements. My own API can perform all three tasks without Apple Intelligence; language support depends on the selected service and model. It does not replace on-device transcription or translation.
- 转写和翻译取决于 Apple 的设备端技术、iPhone 和 iOS 版本。待办、复盘和回答若使用“这台 iPhone”，需要满足 Apple 智能的设备、语言和地区要求；若使用“我自己的 API”，可以不依赖 Apple 智能完成这三项功能，语言支持取决于所选服务和模型。API 不替代设备端的转写或翻译。
- Status: in beta, coming soon to the App Store.
